subject: Compact evening loop for Alexandra Chen — sequence + debrief owner
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Chen <alex.chen@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compact evening loop for Alexandra — availability check

Hi Alexandra — thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. We want to run a compact virtual onsite (four 45-minute slots) in one evening so you don’t have to block multiple days.

Proposed dates/times (all PT):
- Tue Jul 25, 5:30–8:30pm PT (preferred by the hiring team)
- Wed Jul 26, 5:00–8:00pm PT
- Thu Jul 27, 6:00–9:00pm PT

Format: 4 x 45min interviews (technical coding, system design, product/PM-collab, cross-functional architecture) with a 10–15 minute buffer between slots for quick breaks. We’ll keep the cadence tight and follow with a 30-minute debrief (internal).

If any of those nights work, reply with your preferred date + which slot you want earlier/later (we can prioritize technical first or move it to second). I’ve attached your resume for reference and will follow up with the panel sequence once we lock a date.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Hiring Manager — Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: alexandra_chen_resume.pdf
From: Alexandra Chen <alex.chen@gmail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact evening loop for Alexandra — availability check

Hi Vivek — thanks for the note. Tue Jul 25, 5:30–8:30pm PT works best for me. I’d prefer to do coding first while I’m freshest, then system design, then product, then cross-functional.

I have a dietary restriction note for the calendar (not relevant to virtual, but FYI for future onsite): vegetarian.

Looking forward to it.
Alexandra

On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 9:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alexandra — thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood...
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Compact evening loop for Alexandra — sequence + debrief owner

Team — Alexandra confirmed Tue 7/25, 5:30–8:30pm PT and asked to take the coding slot first. Draft sequence below (45m slots + 10m buffer):
1) 5:30–6:15pm PT — Coding (live pair) — Interviewer: Marissa
2) 6:25–7:10pm PT — System design — Interviewer: Kimberly
3) 7:20–8:05pm PT — Product / PM-collab — Interviewer: Vivek (me)
4) 8:15–9:00pm PT — Cross-functional architecture + infra tradeoffs — Interviewer: Laura

Notes / asks:
- Laura: can you own the 30-minute internal debrief immediately after the loop (9:00–9:30pm PT)? We’d like a single debrief owner to capture hiring signals and next steps.
- Marissa: we’ll need a short coding prompt that runs in 45 minutes with a 10m warmup. Can you confirm you have a candidate-facing environment (pairing link)?
- Kimberly: can you bring a focused system-design prompt scoped to 20–30 minute deep-dive and a couple follow-ups?
- Please flag if any of these times conflict. I attached the evening-loop .ics for quick add and the debrief template.

Thanks — I’ll send confirmation to Alexandra once we have final ack.

—Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Compact evening loop for Alexandra — sequence + debrief owner

Thanks Vivek — confirmed on my side for 5:30 start. I have a pairing environment ready (https://codeshare.redwood.com/session/ef3a) and will prune the prompt down to a single scoped problem + 2 extension questions to fit 45 minutes.

Laura — happy to have you own the debrief. I’ll paste a quick evaluator note at the top of the doc at the end of my slot so you don’t have to hunt for artifacts.

Kimberly — do you want me to seed one low-level infra question into the coding prompt or save infra-surface for your slot?

—Marissa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Alexandra Chen <alex.chen@gmail.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final confirmation — Tue Jul 25 5:30pm PT (compact loop)

Hi Alexandra — confirming we’re locked for Tue Jul 25, 5:30–9:00pm PT (your slots are the four 45-minute interviews described below). You should have a calendar invite from me with the Zoom links; please accept when you can.

Final panel sequence (times PT):
- 5:30–6:15pm — Coding with Marissa Cole (pairing link provided in calendar)
- 6:25–7:10pm — System design with Kimberly Park
- 7:20–8:05pm — Product collaboration with Vivek Kulkarni
- 8:15–9:00pm — Cross-functional architecture with Laura Bennett

Internal debrief: 9:00–9:30pm PT (Laura Bennett — debrief owner).

Kimberly sent a quick ack (backup: Jordan Blake is on standby if anything changes). Marissa — thanks for prepping the pairing link; I’ll include your short notes in the debrief doc.

Logistics / reminders for candidate:
- Please join the Zoom from a quiet space and have a webcam + screen-share ready for the coding session.
- If anything changes on your end, reply directly and we’ll reschedule.

Attachments: evening-loop-sequence.ics, debrief-template.docx

Best,
Laura Bennett
Recruiting Lead — Interviews & Ops
Redwood Inference
